title: Fantastic private tour to Monserrat & winery.
text: We had a wonderful private tour with Alex to Monserrat & a winery.  It was raining for the Monserrat portion of the day & Alex was very accommodating.  The sun came out at the winery which was beautiful & historic.  Thank you!
author: kelly b

title: Beautiful Outing!
text:
This was a fantastic trip!  Monserrat was gorgeous.  Our guide Carlos made the trip fun and very educational.  The views from the monastery were breathtaking.  
The wine tasting was fabulous.  The tapas paired well with the wines we tried, and again, Carlos was very knowledgeable and made it very interesting and fun.  After the tasting, we had free time to wander around the grounds of the winery.  It was my favorite outing of our trip.  We are going again in November for a girls' trip, and I plan on reserving this again.  I hope Carlos is our guide!!
author: Compass21152339210

title: Afternoon of delight
text: Alejandro was very knowledgeable. We asked to be taken to places that sell the best quality foods and tapas. He did not disappoint. We had some of the best and most authentic Catalonian dishes. They were things I never would have thought to order at places I would probably have passed up. It was a very enjoyable experience.
author: DayTrip180960

title: Best Tour Guide in Barcelona!
text: Elvira and her team are 7 stars.  Excellent access to places I had never seen before she is well organized and has a very bubbly and sympatico character .  I would recommend her and her team to anyone looking for a great tour experiences!
author: sunlytedotcom

title: A beautiful day in Montserrat
text:
Elvira showed us around Montserrat by car. The landscapes are quite unique and the road to the vineyard is definitely worth a photo. The monastery is beautiful and the museum contains many masterpieces (impressionist painters in particular).
The visit of the vineyard is informative and the tasting quality with local grape varieties that I did not know. Elvira is Catalan so she was able to tell us about her region during the drive to the mountain. In short, I recommend this excursion.
author: 768rapha_lc

title: Super wonderful Catalan experience!
text:
Can I add + than 5 stars? We had a wonderful time with Elvira,our guide and the winery owner and somellier.
The experience was more than what we expected,we learnt about the local wine culture and try the best wines ever!🍷

title: Authentic Montserrat & intime winery
text:
Great experience.Not only visited this Monastery but also we had a premium experience at a secluded winery where we tried high quality wine and meet 5th generation owner.

It is possible to request as well a pick from Barcelona, worth the money. We will book again this tour operator.
